prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable decorative Proof Thread ribbon beneath semantic progress content, 3:1 wide
Input images: Images 1–3 are approved SAPAR comps. Match their exact bright cobalt/cream palette, tactile four-stage journey treatment, polished cartoon-first 2.5D paper-and-enamel finish, and sporting-club warmth only. Do not copy text, icons, values, stamps, layouts, logos, or people.
Primary request: Create an original blank four-node progress ribbon: a gently traveling electric-cobalt thread connects four large tactile empty circular sockets on a warm cream layered plate. The four sockets should have restrained state accents in sequence: court green, coral, cobalt, amber/gold. Every node interior must remain empty for live icons and labels added in code.
Subject: four blank tactile nodes and one connecting route thread, decorative substrate only.
Style/medium: bold polished 2.5D cartoon interface art, paper-cut panels, molded enamel sockets, hand-painted route line, light screenprint grain.
Composition/framing: exact 3:1 wide; all four nodes evenly spaced in one readable horizontal journey; generous margin around the plate; front orthographic view; simple enough to crop responsively.
Color palette: electric cobalt #003CCA, warm cream #FDF9F3, court green #248A57, coral #F36B5F, amber/gold #F6B21A, ink #182035. Avoid color gradients; use flat layered color, highlights, and soft shadows.
Materials/textures: uncoated cream paper, matte painted thread, enamel node rims, subtle embossing.
Constraints: original SAPAR decorative ribbon only. No people, text, letters, numbers, icons, symbols, logos, arrows, checkmarks, calendars, trophies, charts, stamps, badges, government seals, real brands, League of Legends iconography, casino/slot/card/roulette imagery, watermark, or copied trade dress.
